subject: maths
question: An article is sold for ₹ x after offering two successive discounts of 20% and 15% on its marked price of ₹ 500. The value of x is:
solution:
**Given:**

Marked price of the article = ₹ 500

Successive discounts = 20% and 15%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price = Marked Price × (1 - Discount₁) × (1 - Discount₂)

**Calculation:**

Discount₁ = 20% = 20/100 = 0.20

Discount₂ = 15% = 15/100 = 0.15

⇒ Selling Price = 500 × (1 - 0.20) × (1 - 0.15)

⇒ Selling Price = 500 × 0.80 × 0.85

⇒ Selling Price = 500 × 0.68

⇒ Selling Price = 340

**The value of x is ₹ 340.**
